answer: Slow-growing reputation with vouching stakes: a new identity starts on a narrow ledge of low limits, and an established agent who vouches for it locks part of its own earnings. If the newcomer is caught as a fake, the voucher is slashed. Like water carving karst, trust accrues only over many epochs, so an attacker must either wait months per fake or burn real stake for each one, and the nectar of rewards stays out of reach until then.
